item.description: Parenthood can be overwhelming. A therapist and mom of three shares techniques to help calibrate your emotions — so you can show up better for yourself and your family.

item.title: Is Switzerland's neutrality at a crossroads?
item.description: Switzerland is voting on whether to tighten its famous neutrality — a move that could reshape its response to Russia and future conflicts.

item.title: Years after storms, clean-up crews meticulously separate the sentimental from the wreckage
item.description: Across the country, lost-and-found networks seek to reunite objects with disaster survivors. The work can take years. In some cases, it's impossible to pick up all the pieces.

item.title: The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is low. Here's why you should care
item.description: The U.S. has tapped into its strategic oil reserve to help drive down rising gasoline prices in the wake of the war with Iran. Can oil from Venezuela help fill it back up?

item.title: Trump's state dinner for Xi features sea bass and a long list of tech titans
item.description: A tech-heavy guest list, the fashion choices of those on it, who sat where and what was on the menu marked the softer — often and glitzier — details of diplomacy as Donald Trump threw a Thursday night state dinner honoring China's leader Xi Jinping.

item.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died
item.description: James Copenhaver, one of three campaign rally attendees shot in 2024 during an assassination attempt on then-candidate Donald Trump, has died in Pittsburgh, his lawyer said Thursday. He was 76.
